name: 中级模板-核弹发射井
data:
#中级模板不会像基础模板那样注释特别详细，在这里只有新知识和主要的知识点会有注释说明
#请结合注释和助手代码表综合使用该模板
[core]
name: nukeLauncherTemplate
class: CustomUnitMetadata

#直接调用原版核弹发射井描述 请和下方多语言任选一个 去注释即可使用

#displayLocaleKey: NukeLaucher

#多语言
displayText: NukeLaucher(Template)
displayDescription: -Launch a nuclear bomb of massive destruction that can be intercepted by anti-nuclear defenses.

displayText_zh: 示范核弹发射井
displayDescription_zh: -发射拥有巨大毁灭性的核弹，可以被反核防御拦截。

#是否替换原版核弹发射井 下行这里注释了 如果要使用去掉注释
#overrideAndReplace: NukeLaucher

#在禁核模式中是否不能使用这个单位 这里是真 即代表禁核模式中不能使用
isLockedIfGameModeNoNuke:true

price: 45000
maxHp: 1500
mass: 9000

#footprint used for collisions with units (left, up, right, down)
footprint: -1,-1,1,1

#used for placement, and placement of other buildings
constructionFootprint: -2,-1,2,2


techLevel: 1
buildSpeed: 0.001
#availableInDemo: true

radius: 35
#displayRadius: 25
isBio: false
isBuilding: true




exit_x:0
exit_y:-1

#建造核弹
[action_buildNuke]
price:  11000
text: i:gui.actions.buildNuke
description:i:gui.actions.buildNuke.description
displayType: NONE
buildSpeed: 0.0003
pos: 0.2

#如果弹药大于4就会禁止继续建造核弹 也就是原版一个核弹发射井最多4个核弹
isActive:if self.ammoIncludingQueued(lessThan=4)

#添加ammo资源 是一个原版的一个局部资源 它们互不影响 可多用
addResources: ammo=1

#图标图像
iconImage: SHARED:icon_build.png

#AI怎么使用这个单位 Luke虽然写了这些代码但游戏里面AI暂时还不会用核弹攻击玩家
aiUse: launchAmmo


#贴花 就是最新版的核弹发射井没有任何核弹时的那个禁止图标一闪一闪的那个效果
[decal_targetGuide]
alwaysStartDirAtZero: true
layer: inactive

image: SHARED:area_guide.png
teamColors: false

@define area_guide_size: 100
@define area_guide_radius: 50

@define lowDamageBorder: 30

imageScale: ${ projectile_nukeProjectile.areaRadius - lowDamageBorder }/${area_guide_radius}

alpha: 0.4
color: #960d06



#发射核弹
[action_launchNuke]
fireTurretXAtGround: siloTop
fireTurretXAtGround_showGuideDecals: targetGuide

#消耗一个ammo
price:  ammo=1

text: i:gui.actions.launchNuke
description:i:gui.actions.launchNuke.description
displayType: action
buildSpeed: 3.5s
pos: 0.1

#播放动画
whenBuilding_playAnimation: fireNuke


displayRemainingStockpile: true
highPriorityQueue: true
onlyOneUnitAtATime: true


#isAlsoViewableByEnemies: true
iconImage: SHARED:icon_attack_point.png

aiUse: launch

[graphics]
total_frames: 1

image:        CORE:/nukes/nuke_launcher_front.png
image_back:   CORE:/nukes/nuke_launcher_back.png
image_wreak:  CORE:/nukes/nuke_launcher_dead.png

drawLayer: bottom

#scaleImagesTo: 20
#scaleTurretImagesTo: 9

#AUTO
image_shadow: NONE
shadowOffsetX:1
shadowOffsetY:1


[attack]
canAttack: false
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits:   true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false
maxAttackRange: 9999


[movement]
movementType: NONE
moveSpeed: 0
moveAccelerationSpeed: 0.01
moveDecelerationSpeed: 0.01

maxTurnSpeed: 0
turnAcceleration: 0.1




[turret_siloTop]
#nuke turret
canShoot: false

x: 0
y: -5
idleDir:0

invisible: true

shoot_sound:nuke_launch
shoot_sound_vol:0.27
shoot_light:#FFEECCCC

projectile: nukeProjectile
size: 1

turnSpeed: 40


#shoot_flame:shockwave
shoot_flame:custom:nukeLaunch_wave, custom:nukeLaunch_light
#custom:nukeLaunch_smoke*6


limitingMinRange: 260

[projectile_nukeProjectile]
#nuke

#这里的标签将会判定为反核防御的具体目标tag
tags: nuke

directDamage: 123

life: 99999
speed: 0.1
targetSpeed: 2.7
targetSpeedAcceleration:0.02


largeHitEffect: true
ballistic: true
ballistic_delaymove_height:80
ballistic_height: 110
frame: 0
shadowFrame:1

drawType:1

targetGround: true
areaDamage: 5400

#hullDamageMultiplier:0 for EMP version
#hullDamageMultiplier: 0

areaHitAirAndLandAtSameTime: true
alwaysVisibleInFog: true

areaRadius: 250

areaExpandTime:75

deflectionPower:-1

#炸的时候揭开这里的迷雾
shouldRevealFog:true

#核武抛射体 小地图全图警告
nukeWeapon:true

lightColor: #FFEEEE00
lightSize: 1

#友伤 但是伤不了盟军()
friendlyFire: true

#trailEffect: true
trailEffect: CUSTOM:projectileTrail
trailEffectRate:4

#效果组
[effect_projectileTrail]

stripIndex: effects
frameIndex: 0


life: 120
fadeOut: true
attachedToUnit: false
color: #FFFFFF
fadeInTime:5
scaleFrom: 0.5
scaleTo: 3.5
alpha: 0.6
drawUnderUnits:false
#ySpeedRelative:-1
atmospheric:true

dirOffsetRandom:180

shadow:true

xSpeedAbsoluteRandom: 0.2
ySpeedAbsoluteRandom: 0.2


[effect_nukeLaunch_wave]
priority:high

stripIndex:shockwave
life: 50
scaleFrom: 0.5
scaleTo: 2.5

[effect_nukeLaunch_smoke]
priority:high

xOffsetAbsoluteRandom: 10
yOffsetAbsoluteRandom: 10

frameIndex: 0
stripIndex: smoke_black

spawnChance: 0.3

life: 90
fadeOut: true
attachedToUnit: false
#color: #fdc14d
color: #FFEEEE00

fadeInTime:5
scaleFrom: 0.3
scaleTo: 0.8
alpha: 0.9
drawUnderUnits:false
liveAfterAttachedDies: false
hSpeed:0.4
xSpeedAbsoluteRandom:0.9
ySpeedAbsoluteRandom:0.9
dirOffsetRandom:180
atmospheric: true


[effect_nukeLaunch_light]
image: SHARED:light_50.png
life: 40
fadeOut: true
attachedToUnit: true
color: #FFFFFF
scaleFrom: 1.7
scaleTo: 1.7
alpha: 0.7
drawUnderUnits:false


#随机生成一个坦克并被炸死（
[projectile_randomTankNuke]
#tank nuke :p

directDamage: 123

spawnUnit: tank

life: 99999
speed: 0.1
targetSpeed: 2.7
targetSpeedAcceleration:0.02

trailEffect: true
largeHitEffect: true
ballistic: true
ballistic_delaymove_height:80
ballistic_height: 110
frame: 0
shadowFrame:1

drawType:1

targetGround: true

#激光拦截-1，即无法使用激光拦截该炮弹
deflectionPower:-1

lightColor: #FFEEEE00
lightSize: 1


#核弹发射井的那两个门
[arm_1]
x:3
y:-1
image_end:CORE:/nukes/nuke_launcher_door_r.png


#x:13
#y:-9

#核弹发射井的那两个门
[arm_2]
x:-5
y:9
image_end:CORE:/nukes/nuke_launcher_door_l.png

#x:-14
#y:14

#核弹发射井的发射前的开门动画
[animation_fireNuke]

blendIn: 2s
blendOut: 2.5s

arm1_0: {x:10, y:-8}
arm2_0: {x:-9, y:5}

#arm1_0s: {x:0, y:0}
#arm2_0s: {x:0, y:0} 

#arm1_1.400s: {x:10, y:-8}
#arm2_1.400s: {x:-9, y:5}

[ai]

buildPriority: 0.01

noneInBaseExtraPriority: 0.04

noneGlobalExtraPriority: 0.1


maxEachBase: 0

ai_upgradePriority: 0.2

aiTags: nukeLauncher, launcher
